description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Siren of the Silent Song, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Siren of the Silent Song.
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard a card and mill a card.
Repeat.

uses.name: Pemmin's Aura
uses.cardState: attached to Siren of the Silent Song
